summary: Company transitioned ReWalk manufacturing to Yokneam, Israel facility in Q2 2025. Management expects gross margin improvement from higher revenue absorption of fixed overhead and operational efficiencies.
quote: Beginning in the second quarter of 2025, the Company transitioned the manufacturing of its ReWalk exoskeleton products to its facility in Yokneam, Israel

summary: Company increased production at own facilities to 89% of domestic volume in first half 2026 from 80% in prior year, reducing dependence on third-party contract production.
quote: Company produced approximately 84% and 89%, respectively, of its domestic volume at Company-owned production facilities

summary: Q2 2026 global production hours decreased 1.0% year-over-year, reflecting weaker demand in multiple regions. However, H1 2026 production hours increased 6.2%, showing AGCO adjusted production to respond to earlier-year demand strength and regional variations.
quote: Overall, global production hours increased (decreased) approximately (1.0)% and 6.2% during the three and six months ended June 30, 2026, respectively, compared to the same periods in 2025

summary: Gross margin benefited from favorable product mix but was offset by unfavorable manufacturing efficiencies and higher excess/obsolescence charges in Q2 2026.
quote: The increase was partially offset by unfavorable manufacturing efficiencies and higher excess and obsolescence charges during the period.

summary: Capital expenditures increased to $18.8M (from $6.9M prior year) focused on manufacturing equipment, tissue processing, software development, and leasehold improvements to support revenue growth.
quote: Capital expenditures for the six months ended June 30, 2026 were primarily related to computer software development, purchases of manufacturing and tissue processing equipment, and leasehold improvements.

summary: Company faces challenges related to timely and effective execution of manufacturing strategies and capacity utilization of facilities, which affects operational efficiency.
quote: issues relating to the ability to timely and effectively execute on manufacturing strategies, general efficiencies, and capacity utilization of the Company's facilities

summary: VSD experienced unfavorable factory utilization in Q2 despite higher volumes, while PSD saw favorable factory utilization gains. MSD showed volume growth but unfavorable product mix.
quote: Gross profit as a percentage of net revenues for VSD increased for the three months ended June 30, 2026 compared to the prior quarter, primarily due to higher revenue volumes, lower excess and obsolete inventory charges and lower tariff and duty costs, partially offset by unfavorable factory utilization and product mix.

summary: Lower EXPAREL production volumes led to higher product costs, partially offset by fewer inventory reserves and less downtime in current year versus prior year.
quote: Gross margin was flat and decreased one percentage point due to higher EXPAREL product costs resulting from lower production volumes. This was substantially offset by fewer inventory reserves and less downtime in the current year.

summary: Company deploying strategic manufacturing relocations to mitigate tariff and cost pressures, representing both one-time adjustment costs and longer-term operational resilience.
quote: productivity initiatives and strategic manufacturing relocations, where appropriate

summary: Company holds $1.9B inventory with 6.9M barrel hedged positions showing $63M unrealized gain. 10% commodity price change impacts ~$42M. Volatile fuel prices create both risks and opportunities.
quote: As of June 30, 2026, we held approximately $1.90 billion of such inventory. The Partnership had derivative positions on 6.9 million barrels with an aggregate unrealized gain of $63 million.

summary: Strong biopreservation media demand growth (21-23%) contrasts with cost of revenue growth (24-31%), suggesting capacity constraints or inefficiencies in scaling production to meet demand surge.
quote: Cost of revenue increased $2.0 million, or 24%, for the three months ended June 30, 2026 compared to the same period in 2025. Cost of revenue increased $4.7 million, or 31%, for the six months ended June 30, 2026 compared to the same period in 2025.

summary: Restructuring initiative approved May 2025 to improve operational performance and reduce costs by directing resources to highest-growth markets and geographies.
quote: Market and regional alignment initiative designed to improve operational performance and reduce costs by directing the Company's resources toward the markets and geographies that offer the greatest growth and portfolio advancement opportunities.

summary: Company has $8.3 million in capital expenditure and raw material purchase commitments, indicating moderate capex investment to support growth and production.
quote: At June 30, 2026, the Company had $8.3 million of commitments primarily for capital expenditures and purchase of raw materials to be used in production and finished goods.

summary: Company monitors Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) as a key performance indicator to track utilization and productivity improvements across manufacturing assets. OEE data presented for comparison across segments and periods.
quote: We measure OEE of each of our mills to track improvements in the utilization and productivity of our manufacturing assets.

summary: Fluctuations in demand and capacity utilization levels impact unit manufacturing costs, though recent shipment growth of 1.7% in Q3 provides modest benefit.
quote: the impact of fluctuations in demand and capacity utilization levels on our unit manufacturing costs
